experiment: Evidence lease to close the snapshot-then-effect TOCTOU gap under a cooperating authority contract

local_regression_suite.note: The inherited v1.9 test_external_evidence_can_change_after_dispatch_snapshot intentionally reproduces the legacy TOCTOU gap as a negative-control test; it passes by asserting the vulnerable outcome.

concurrent_evidence_race.invariant: Update-first must deny lease; lease-first must block evidence update while valid lease is active.

not_established: full upstream package test suite and CI
real external evidence service honoring leases
real payment or deployment provider atomic idempotency
out-of-band evidence writes not routed through the lease authority
production clock skew, key management, or security review
authoritative fencing/recovery for an abandoned IN_FLIGHT remote call
scope_note: The lease protocol is executable and verified within a single-host SQLite reference implementation. Its TOCTOU guarantee depends on all relevant evidence writes honoring leases and the effect provider respecting the pinned in-flight lease through effect resolution. No upstream files were modified.
